name: Facebook Pages
label: Facebook Pages — Graph API v26.0
description: Official Meta Graph API v26.0 for a Facebook Page on https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Page feed publish/list, insights, Lead Ads form list, generic Page-scoped GET/POST/DELETE. page_access_token is never logged or returned. Instagram stays on the Instagram node. Do not scrape facebook.com. Customer owns the Meta app.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put page_access_token here. Example: {"operation":"page_post_create","page_id":"123","message":"Hello"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: graph_get | page_post_create | page_feed_get | insights_get | lead_list | graph_post | graph_delete | trigger.

schema.label: path
schema.description: graph_get / graph_post path after version. No scheme/host. Slash in the value is URL-encoded — prefer a single object id, or use page_* ops for /feed edges.

schema.label: page_id
schema.description: Path {page_id} for page_post_create, page_feed_get, insights_get, lead_list.

schema.label: message
schema.description: Page post text for page_post_create / graph_post. Official message.

schema.label: link
schema.description: page_post_create / graph_post URL. Graph must be able to fetch it.

schema.label: metric
schema.description: insights_get comma-separated metrics valid on v26.0. Do not send metrics Meta removed after 2026-06-15.

schema.label: period
schema.description: insights_get period: day | week | days_28 | lifetime as documented.

schema.label: object_id
schema.description: graph_delete path {object_id}. Page-owned object the token may delete.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Lead payloads are PII — do not log data. trigger is ingress. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (feed, insights, forms, or Graph object). May contain lead PII — do not log.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT values listed in options. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Page access token
configurationParameters.description: Facebook Page access token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT. Empty → no HTTP.

configurationParameters.label: page_id
configurationParameters.description: Default Page id when INPUT page_id is empty.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.

configurationParameters.label: Meta App Secret
configurationParameters.description: Meta App Secret for constant-time X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC-SHA256 verification. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Verify Token
configurationParameters.description: Shared verify token checked during Meta GET hub.mode=subscribe handshake. Never logged.
